name: Drawers
summary: An FAQ built as a filing cabinet: pull a drawer and its answer card rises out, with live search
about: A frequently asked questions section shaped like a steel filing cabinet with brass label holders and cup pulls. Pressing a question jiggles the pull, slides the drawer out toward you and lifts an index card with the answer out of it, with a little dust in the air. A search box files away the drawers that do not match, highlights the words that do, and each card asks if it helped and stamps a thank you.
how: Press a drawer: the pull jiggles, the drawer slides out and the answer card rises from inside it. Any other open drawer closes.
Press it again to slide it shut with a small thunk of the cabinet.
Type in the search box: drawers that do not match slide away one after another and the matching words are highlighted.
Use the Up and Down arrow keys to move between drawers, Enter in the search box to open the first match and Escape to clear it.
Answer Yes or No under a card; Yes stamps a thank you on it.
